description: Intercepts requests matching a URL pattern and returns a malformed or corrupted response, simulating partial network failures at the protocol level. Use to answer: does the app handle malformed JSON, content-length lies, or truncated payloads without crashing?

corruption_type.description: Type of corruption: malformed_json (unterminated JSON body), length_mismatch (content-length claims 99999 bytes but body is short), truncated (body cut off at truncate_at_byte)

fallback_selector.description: CSS selector for the fallback UI that should appear (e.g., '.parse-error')

intercept_pattern.description: Glob pattern for requests to corrupt (e.g., '**/api/data**')

truncate_at_byte.description: Byte offset to truncate at (only used when corruption_type is truncated)

url.description: URL of the page to test

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before checking state (default: 2000)

name: inject_response_corruption
